text: Norman Taylor, a rationalist professor lecturing on superstition at an English university, discovers his wife Tansy has been [guarding his career with conjure magic|rules|faith and charms protect] learned in Jamaica. He forces her to [burn her charms and paraphernalia|trigger|breaking a rule], and at once a student accuses him, someone tries to break in during a thunderstorm, and Tansy nearly drowns herself to save him. Someone envious of [his rapid advancement|wants|wealth and ambition] is working against them, while a [giant stone eagle|images|animals and birds] perches on the chapel roof.
